stories.title: Series Preview — Cubs vs Reds, 3-Game Series Opens at Wrigley

x_posts.label: Post 1
x_posts.text:
Cubs vs. Reds. Three games. Wrigley Field.

Peterson (7-7, 5.17 ERA) faces Lowder (5-8, 5.13 ERA) — near-identical ERAs, but the Cubs are home and hungry.

76-58. Back in Chicago. Time to reset.

#Cubs #GoCubs #FlyTheW

stories.title: Justin Steele Return Watch — October Bullpen Weapon

x_posts.label: Post 2
x_posts.text:
Justin Steele threw live batting practice this week and is nearing a MiLB rehab assignment.

He's not starting in 2026 — but as a high-leverage October bullpen arm, he's the Cubs' best-kept postseason secret.

The depth is REAL.

#Cubs #GoCubs #MLB

stories.title: Pete Crow-Armstrong MVP Watch — 7.7 fWAR, 2nd Straight 30-30 Pace

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
Pete Crow-Armstrong: 33 HR, 7.7 fWAR, 155 OPS+.

He leads ALL of baseball in fWAR, is on pace for his 2nd straight 30-30 season, and 29 of 37 MLB experts just voted him NL MVP No. 1.

Ohtani hasn't pitched since July 3. The trophy is PCA's to lose.

#Cubs #GoCubs #ChicagoCubs

stories.title: Wild Card + Cardinals Rival Jab — Cardinals 67-68, Nine Back

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
NL Wild Card, August 28:

Cubs: 76-58 (WC No. 1)
Cardinals: 67-68

St. Louis is officially a .500 casualty nine games back with 28 to play.

The North Side has zero interest in the rearview.

stories.title: Game Day Hype — First Pitch 80 Minutes Out

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text:
First pitch in 80 minutes. Wrigley Field.

Peterson (7-7, 5.17 ERA) takes the hill vs. a Reds team that's 63-71 and going nowhere.

Five losses in seven on the road. The Cubs have something to prove today.

1:20 PM CT. Let's go.

#Cubs #FlyTheW #GoCubs

stories.title: Jaxon Wiggins September Callup Watch — 4 Straight Hitless Relief Outings

x_posts.label: Post 6
x_posts.text:
Jaxon Wiggins: 4 straight scoreless Triple-A relief outings. Zero hits. Six K. 98 mph.

The Cubs' No. 2 prospect found something in the bullpen — and a September callup is a matter of when, not if.

October is getting louder.

#Cubs #GoCubs #ChicagoCubs
